title: Runic Ward
text:
Runic Ward (or Ward) is a resource granted by items related to Expedition. If the user's life is reduced below 1, damage will be taken from Runic Ward to attempt to prevent the user's death. Runic Ward is also used as a cost for Kalguuran skills.


== Mechanics ==
Mechanically, Runic Ward can be thought of as energy shield in reverse; all damage will be taken from life before runic ward. If an instance of damage were to exceed the user's life and runic ward pool, they will still die.
Runic Ward has a base regeneration rate of 5% per second.
Monsters with any amount of Runic Ward are immune to Culling Strike.
